create_empirical_covariance: create a function that computes the maximum likelihood covariance estimator from input data array
build_EmpiricalCovariance: build an EmpiricalCovariance estimator object to fit covariance from training data and store precision matrix
test_log_likelihood: test the log_likelihood function that computes sample mean of log-likelihood under a covariance model
run_EmpiricalCovariance_score: run the EmpiricalCovariance score method to compute log-likelihood of test data under the fitted Gaussian model
run_EmpiricalCovariance_mahalanobis: run the EmpiricalCovariance mahalanobis method to compute squared Mahalanobis distances of observations
